Title: Create repository structure and solution
Goal: Create the initial VetFlow repository and approved project structure.
Acceptance Criteria: Repository contains the approved structure. | Backend builds successfully. | Angular builds successfully. | Tests execute successfully. | No circular project dependencies. | A developer can clone and understand where each future feature belongs.

Title: Configure coding standards and quality gates
Goal: Make the repository enforce consistent engineering standards.
Acceptance Criteria: Backend and frontend checks run in CI. | Formatting/analyzer violations are surfaced. | Build/test failures fail the pipeline. | No application behavior is changed.

Title: Create local development environment
Goal: Provide a reproducible local environment for PostgreSQL, Keycloak and object storage.
Acceptance Criteria: All infrastructure starts with one documented command. | PostgreSQL, Keycloak and MinIO are reachable. | Persistent volumes survive restart. | Secrets are not committed.

Title: Configure PostgreSQL and EF Core
Goal: Create the persistence foundation without business tables.
Acceptance Criteria: Both contexts can connect. | A test migration can be generated/applied. | Connection strings come from configuration/secrets. | No business tables are introduced outside the intended scope.

Title: Create API foundation
Goal: Create ASP.NET Core API pipeline and common API behavior.
Acceptance Criteria: API starts successfully. | OpenAPI is generated. | Health endpoint works. | Validation/business errors have consistent shape. | Unhandled errors do not leak internals.

Title: Create Angular PWA shell
Goal: Create one Angular application with route-separated Platform, Business and Portal areas.
Acceptance Criteria: One Angular application exists. | All three route areas resolve. | No second Angular application is created. | PWA install/service-worker configuration is valid. | Responsive shell works on desktop and mobile widths.

Title: Create design system foundation
Goal: Create the reusable UI primitives without creating generic business components.
Acceptance Criteria: Core UI primitives render consistently. | Theme matches approved clinical SaaS direction. | No business-specific behavior is hidden in generic components.

Title: Configure OpenTelemetry
Goal: Add trace/log/metric instrumentation foundation.
Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry is visible locally. | Sensitive values are excluded. | Trace IDs correlate API operations.

Title: Create test architecture
Goal: Create unit, integration, API, security and workflow test foundations.
Acceptance Criteria: A sample unit test passes. | A sample API integration test passes. | Test infrastructure can create isolated test data. | No production DB is used by automated tests.

Title: Create deployment containerization
Goal: Containerize backend, frontend and workers at a baseline level.
Acceptance Criteria: Images build reproducibly. | Containers start with required environment variables. | Images contain no secrets.

Title: Create Platform DB tenant model
Goal: Implement control-plane tenant and subscription metadata.
Acceptance Criteria: Platform migration creates required tables. | Tenant lifecycle can be persisted. | Tenant database mapping is represented. | Unit tests cover lifecycle transitions.

Title: Implement tenant database resolver
Goal: Resolve the tenant database from trusted authenticated context.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized request gets correct tenant context. | Inactive tenant is rejected. | Missing tenant context is rejected. | Cross-tenant test fails safely.

Title: Implement tenant provisioning workflow
Goal: Provision a tenant database and initial configuration.
Acceptance Criteria: A tenant can be provisioned from Platform UI/API. | Partial failures leave a recoverable provisioning state. | Repeated provisioning does not corrupt the tenant. | Ready is only reached after all required steps succeed.

Title: Integrate Keycloak OIDC
Goal: Use Keycloak for authentication.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid Keycloak user can authenticate. | Invalid/expired token is rejected. | API receives trusted identity. | Passwords are not stored in VetFlow.

Title: Implement application roles and permissions
Goal: Implement VetFlow authorization independent of Keycloak authentication.
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthorized API calls return 403. | Cross-tenant access is denied. | Branch restrictions are enforced. | Frontend cannot bypass server authorization.

Title: Implement global reference metadata
Goal: Centralize global metadata in Platform DB.
Acceptance Criteria: Seed is repeatable. | Global metadata is available to tenant workflows. | No cross-DB foreign keys are required.

Title: Implement branches and practice settings
Goal: Create branch and practice configuration.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can create multiple branches. | Users can be restricted to branches. | Settings are tenant/branch scoped as designed.

Title: Implement platform admin UI
Goal: Create the Super Admin tenant lifecycle UI.
Acceptance Criteria: Super Admin can create and inspect tenants. | Provisioning state is visible. | Non-platform users cannot access routes or APIs.

Title: Implement client management
Goal: Implement client registration, search and duplicate detection.
Acceptance Criteria: Staff can search clients. | Likely duplicates are surfaced before creation. | Client can own multiple animals. | Unauthorized tenant access is impossible.

Title: Implement animal registration
Goal: Implement animal/patient profile and ownership.
Acceptance Criteria: Animal can be created for a client. | Multiple responsible parties are supported where configured. | Reference IDs resolve centrally. | Clinical history protection is enforced.

Title: Implement patient timeline
Goal: Create the read-oriented patient timeline.
Acceptance Criteria: Timeline is chronological. | Each event links to its source. | Tenant/branch/client authorization applies. | Large timelines remain paginated.

Title: Implement client portal account linkage
Goal: Allow a client to receive secure portal access and authorized pet access.
Acceptance Criteria: Client can authenticate. | Only authorized pets appear. | Removing access removes portal visibility. | Portal APIs enforce the same rule server-side.

Title: Implement appointment types and availability foundation
Goal: Create appointment configuration and provider/branch availability.
Acceptance Criteria: Configured appointment type can be selected. | Availability respects branch/provider rules. | Timezone behavior is tested.

Title: Implement appointment booking
Goal: Implement create/confirm/reschedule/cancel appointment workflows.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid appointment can be booked. | Conflicting appointment is rejected. | State transitions are server controlled. | Outbox event is created atomically.

Title: Implement check-in and waiting queue
Goal: Implement arrival, check-in and queue management.
Acceptance Criteria: Reception can check in an appointment. | Walk-in can enter queue. | Queue reflects current state. | Check-in creates/links visit context.

Title: Implement encounter lifecycle
Goal: Create encounter aggregate/workflow and finalization.
Acceptance Criteria: Encounter can be started from checked-in patient. | Incomplete required data blocks completion. | Completed encounter cannot be casually edited. | EncounterCompleted outbox message is persisted.

Title: Implement diagnosis and treatment
Goal: Add diagnosis and treatment capture to encounter.
Acceptance Criteria: Clinician can record diagnosis/treatment. | Finalization preserves attribution. | Corrections are controlled/audited.

Title: Implement follow-up workflow
Goal: Create reusable follow-up records for clinical workflows.
Acceptance Criteria: Clinical workflow can create follow-up. | Follow-up appears on dashboard/portal when permitted. | Completion is auditable.

Title: Implement product and medication catalog
Goal: Create tenant product/medication catalog and batches.
Acceptance Criteria: Product and batch can be created. | Expired batch is identified. | Units are validated.

Title: Implement prescription workflow
Goal: Implement draft/issue prescription and clinical dosing details.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid prescription can be issued. | Required clinical fields are validated. | Prescriber is recorded. | Cancelled prescription cannot be dispensed.

Title: Implement dispensing and inventory deduction
Goal: Dispense prescriptions with batch/expiry validation and auditable stock movement.
Acceptance Criteria: Expired batch cannot be dispensed. | Partial dispense is supported. | Stock movement is auditable. | Repeated request cannot double-deduct stock.

Title: Implement diagnostic orders
Goal: Create diagnostic order and item workflow.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized clinician can order. | Order appears in pending work queue. | Cancellation is controlled.

Title: Implement sample collection
Goal: Capture sample collection and chain-of-custody fields.
Acceptance Criteria: Sample can be collected only for eligible order. | Collection is auditable. | State transition is enforced.

Title: Implement results and veterinarian review
Goal: Implement result entry, report generation and review.
Acceptance Criteria: Result cannot be marked reviewed without required reviewer. | Reviewed result changes are audited. | Client notification occurs only according to configured policy.

Title: Implement vaccination business workflow
Goal: Implement vaccination as a real veterinary workflow, not a generic record.
Acceptance Criteria: All required vaccination fields are captured. | Validity dates are not conflated with next due/follow-up. | Expired vaccine cannot be administered where policy prohibits it. | Follow-up is created with correct relationship. | Vaccination appears on timeline. | Finalized vaccination cannot be silently edited.

Title: Implement procedure and surgery workflow
Goal: Support consent, pre-op, anesthesia, procedure, recovery and post-op.
Acceptance Criteria: Required pre-op/consent rules are enforced where configured. | Each stage is attributable. | Final surgery record is auditable. | Post-op follow-up can be created.

Title: Implement hospitalization
Goal: Support admission through discharge/transfer/referral.
Acceptance Criteria: Patient can be admitted. | Active hospitalized patients are visible. | Discharge requires configured completion criteria. | Discharge creates summary/follow-up as appropriate.

Title: Implement inventory transactions
Goal: Implement auditable stock movement model.
Acceptance Criteria: Every stock change has a transaction. | Inventory can be reconciled. | Negative stock policy is configurable/enforced.

Title: Implement suppliers and purchase orders
Goal: Support procurement and receiving.
Acceptance Criteria: Received quantity matches inventory movement. | Batch is traceable to supplier/PO. | Partial receipt is supported.

Title: Implement service catalog and charges
Goal: Create tenant service catalog and clinical-to-billing charge capture.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can configure service prices. | Clinical workflow can create charges. | Charges are traceable.

Title: Implement estimates and invoices
Goal: Implement estimate-to-invoice workflow.
Acceptance Criteria: Estimate can be converted into charges/invoice. | Invoice state transitions are enforced. | Paid invoice cannot be silently edited.

Title: Implement payments and refunds
Goal: Implement payment allocation, receipts and controlled refunds.
Acceptance Criteria: Partial payment works. | Invoice becomes Paid only when balance reaches zero. | Refund is controlled and auditable. | Receipt can be generated as PDF.

Title: Implement document storage abstraction
Goal: Create secure object storage infrastructure without a universal business document abstraction.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant documents are isolated. | Unauthorized download is rejected. | Object path is not treated as authorization. | Storage can later switch provider.

Title: Implement vaccination certificate PDF
Goal: Generate a professional printable/downloadable vaccination certificate.
Acceptance Criteria: Certificate is readable on A4. | All required vaccination data appears. | PDF can be downloaded. | PDF can be printed consistently. | Document is linked to source vaccination. | Corrections produce a new version rather than silently overwriting.

Title: Implement clinical and billing PDFs
Goal: Implement separate PDF documents for prescription, lab report, discharge summary, invoice and receipt.
Acceptance Criteria: Each document renders correctly. | Each source record maps to its own document rules. | No universal business document abstraction is introduced.

Title: Implement portal dashboard and pet records
Goal: Expose authorized pet information through a dedicated portal experience.
Acceptance Criteria: Client sees only authorized pets. | Mobile portal is usable. | Staff-only fields are not exposed.

Title: Implement portal documents, prescriptions, labs and billing
Goal: Complete client self-service document and financial access.
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthorized documents cannot be accessed. | Reviewed/shareable lab results appear. | PDF downloads are secure.

Title: Implement notification orchestration
Goal: Create outbox-driven notification workflow without directly coupling clinical modules to providers.
Acceptance Criteria: Notification work is durable. | Provider failure does not corrupt clinical transaction. | Retries are bounded/idempotent.

Title: Implement operational dashboards
Goal: Create dashboards for appointments, queue, clinical activity and follow-ups.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard data respects tenant/branch authorization. | Queries are paginated/optimized. | No cross-tenant data.

Title: Implement financial and inventory reports
Goal: Create financial and inventory reporting.
Acceptance Criteria: Totals reconcile with source transactions. | Reports respect date/timezone and branch scope. | Large reports do not block request threads unnecessarily.

Title: Implement tenant isolation regression suite
Goal: Prove tenant and portal isolation.
Acceptance Criteria: All isolation tests pass. | Any unauthorized access returns safe denial. | Regression suite runs in CI.

Title: Implement backup and restore validation
Goal: Make data recovery testable.
Acceptance Criteria: Backup success is observable. | A tenant can be restored in a controlled test. | Recovery procedures are documented.

Title: Production readiness hardening
Goal: Harden the application for production.
Acceptance Criteria: Critical security findings resolved. | Critical workflows meet agreed performance targets. | Production runbook exists. | Release checklist passes.

Title: Create AI-safe data access boundary
Goal: Prepare future AI services without giving models direct unrestricted DB access.
Acceptance Criteria: AI cannot bypass normal authorization. | Data access is tenant scoped. | Sensitive data access is auditable.

Title: Create AI suggestion workflow contract
Goal: Allow future AI assistants to return drafts requiring human acceptance.
Acceptance Criteria: AI suggestions cannot directly finalize clinical records. | Acceptance is explicit. | Provider/model can change without changing clinical workflow contracts.
